text:
Maya: Heads-up — nightly eval shows a clear quality regression after the attention kernel tweak merged yesterday. customer_prompt_set BLEU down ~12% and several few-shot completions are truncated or repeaty. Repro: ./tools/eval.sh --suite customer_prompt_set --model rdx-13b-v2-kernel-optim

Raj: yikes. Which change are we blaming? the fused-attn kernel or sampling wrapper?

Lin: suspecting the fused-attn commit. Commit 9f3b2a7 modified RNG handling when we switched to block-fused loops; looks like we reseed per-block. Quick check shows different outputs even with same global seed.

Eva: I saw odd truncation earlier in quant nightlies but thought it was quant noise. Minimal repro I used: 
```
python -m rdx.eval.run \n  --model rdx-13b-v2-kernel-optim \n  --prompts tests/customer_case_17.json \n  --seed 42 \n  --sampling top_p=0.9 temp=0.8
```
Outputs diverge between baseline and new kernel.

Sasha: can we bisect to the PR? which PR touched RNG?

Maya: PR #3124 (commit 9f3b2a7) — it consolidated curand calls into the new fused path. Unit tests passed because CPU/deterministic path wasn't covering fused GPU path. Nightly runs exercise it.

ci-bot: CI Note: nightly build 1764123400 includes PR 3124; perf tests OK.

Raj: quick experiment: I ran the same prompt with ENV RDX_FORCE_OLD_RNG=1 which forces the legacy RNG path. BLEU restored to baseline for that run. So strong evidence it's the RNG/seeding change.

Lin: ok. Root cause likely per-block reseed + mixed use of curandStates and host-side seed calls. Patch plan: preserve global curand state across kernel launches and avoid calling curandSetPseudoRandomGeneratorSeed inside the tiled loop. I'll draft a small fix.

Maya: please also add a regression test that ensures deterministic outputs for a seeded run across attention tiling (small golden file). And add an eval alert threshold (fail nightly if BLEU delta >5%).

Sasha: ops — can we hold the PR rollout on staging/dedicated until a fix lands? I can revert if needed.

Eva: filing tickets and uploading failing outputs now: RED-1258 (regression + artifacts) and RED-1259 (sampling index off-by-one discovered while triaging). Link: http://redwood/issue/RED-1258

Raj: FYI while looking deeper I also found a sampling off-by-one in sampling.cu (around indexing for top-k buckets) — might explain some weird token spikes. Logged that as RED-1259. Could be separate but worth fixing in the same window.

Maya: great. If someone can push a hotfix PR that preserves the old RNG semantics in fused path, we can re-run the nightly earlier. Otherwise revert PR 3124 on staging.

ci-bot: Revert of PR 3124 scheduled by ops at 1764123600; nightly rerun queued.

Sasha: pushing revert to staging now, will update when rerun completes.

Maya: thanks team — keep notes in RED-1258 and paste small reproducer here so eng-runtime can include it in unit coverage. :thumbsup:
